title: Press Center – Bank of America Chicago Marathon
claims: The event welcomes runners from more than 100 countries and all 50 states, including professionals, regional and Masters runners, veterans, debut marathoners and charity runners.
An estimated 1.7 million spectators line the streets cheering on 55,000 runners from the start to the final stretch down Columbus Drive, through 29 neighbourhoods.

The seven AbbottWMM races are Tokyo, Boston presented by Bank of America, TCS London, TCS Sydney, BMW BERLIN, Bank of America Chicago and TCS New York City; the inaugural series ran from Boston in April 2006 to New York City in November 2007.
